name: Knott's Mrs. Knott's Warm Boysenberry Scone with Whipped Butter
brandOrRestaurant: Mrs. Knott's Chicken Dinner Restaurant (Knott's Berry Farm)
whyItWorks: Unlike the whole berry pie, Knott's famous breakfast scone is glazed with strained seedless boysenberry icing. Soft, crumbly, and comforting with zero abrasive whole berry seeds.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Boysenberry Scone warm with whipped sweet butter.
